subject: ACME trial — procurement & billing readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme.com>, Paul Ng <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: ACME trial — quick recap & procurement questions

Thanks again for your time on the call today — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we all have alignment: 

- Trial scope: 30-day eval for the search/autocomplete flow (approx. 50k tokens/day expected at peak).
- Success criteria (what we agreed to track): conversion uplift on search results, 95th percentile latency < 300ms, and stable token cost within expected budget.
- Trial billing: plan to start paid billing when ACME confirms readiness (we discussed either PO or card or purchase via AWS Marketplace).

Open items for procurement:
1) Does ACME prefer to purchase via PO or corporate card?
2) If PO, who is the procurement contact and do you have a standard procurement form we should fill out?
3) Are you interested in doing the purchase through your cloud marketplace account (e.g., AWS Marketplace)? That path can simplify internal approvals for some customers.

Attachments: I can attach an SOW and a simple procurement form stub if helpful — happy to fill details.

Next steps: Samira to confirm procurement preference + internal PO contact; we (Redwood) to share SOW + procurement form. Neha will join the kickoff once procurement is confirmed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

---
Attachment stub: SOW_Redwood_ACME_v1.pdf (SOW, 2 pages)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Ng <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ACME trial — quick recap & procurement questions

Thanks Marissa — great call. A few answers from our side: 

- Purchase method: Procurement prefers PO for anything over $10k. For smaller pilots we sometimes use a corporate card, but for a 30-day pilot at the scale discussed we will likely need a PO.
- Procurement contact: Paul Ng (cc'd) is handling this and will share our vendor onboarding form.
- Marketplace: We have an AWS Marketplace account, but for vendors we haven't onboarded there yet. If Redwood supports Marketplace invoicing, that would be helpful — but it's not a hard requirement.

I'll put Paul in touch with your procurement/legal contact. Can you send the SOW and a filled procurement stub that we can attach to the PO?

Thanks,
Samira
Sr. Product Manager, Search 
ACME Corporation

---
Attachment stub: Procurement_Form_ACME.xlsx (empty for now)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: ACME trial — procurement approach + billing start

Marissa — quick internal note on options so we can present a clean path to Paul: 

Option A — PO (preferred by ACME):
- Standard Redwood SOW + vendor onboarding form.
- Net 30 payment terms on invoice after trial start (can propose Net 15 if they push).
- We can accept PO and invoice monthly.

Option B — Marketplace purchase (via AWS):
- Simpler approvals for ACME but requires Redwood to be listed and invoicing goes through AWS process. Onboarding to Marketplace typically takes 2–3 weeks.

Option C — Card:
- Fastest to start but ACME said their preference is PO for this spend level.

Trial-to-paid handoff: recommend we set the trial start date for billing purposes as the day ACME confirms procurement (PO signed) OR 14 days after trial kickoff if no PO is received (we can use a grace period). For conversion triggers, propose: sustained usage > 30k tokens/day for 7 consecutive days OR explicit product-acceptance sign-off from Samira.

I'm happy to draft the SOW language that references start-of-billing and acceptance criteria. Dev, could you confirm contract/legal redlines to watch for on the vendor form?

-Neha
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme.com>, Paul Ng <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME trial — procurement & billing questions

Samira/Paul — attaching a draft SOW and a pre-filled procurement stub to speed things up. Highlights:

- Trial length: 30 days starting on the kickoff date.
- Billing start: we propose billing to start when a PO is issued (PO effective date), or automatically 14 days after kickoff if no PO is received — whichever comes first. We can be flexible on the exact trigger if ACME prefers.
- Conversion triggers: any of the following will flag an account for conversion discussion:
  * Sustained usage > 30k tokens/day for 7 consecutive days, or
  * Completion of the acceptance checklist (accuracy/latency targets met), or
  * Explicit sign-off from Samira/product owner.

Please review the attached SOW and the procurement XLSX. Paul — if you send your vendor onboarding form I will have our legal fill in required fields; Dev is cc'd to help with any contract questions.

Next steps: 
1) Paul to send completed procurement onboarding or indicate PO timeline.
2) We schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff once procurement is in place.

Thanks again — I can get a DocuSign-ready SOW if you prefer.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: SOW_Redwood_ACME_v1.pdf, Procurement_Form_ACME.xlsx

From: Paul Ng <procurement@acme.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ACME trial — procurement & billing readiness

Marissa — thanks for the SOW and stub. Attached is ACME's vendor onboarding form (completed) and a preliminary PO request. We intend to route this through our procurement system this week.

We prefer PO (Net 30). If you can confirm the SOW via DocuSign and provide an invoice once the PO is issued, we'll target billing to begin the week of 2026-06-21. Also happy to go via AWS Marketplace if you have that option available quickly — please let me know.

Attachments: ACME_Vendor_Onboarding_Completed.pdf, PO_Request_ACME_000472.pdf

Paul Ng
